---
title: Test der Elementfunktionen Wärmeleitung 2D
---

```{julia}
using MMJMesh
using MMJMesh.Meshes
using MMJMesh.Plots
import CairoMakie
include("../projekt/src/heat.jl")
```

## Netz

```{julia}
coords = [0.0 1.2 0.3; 0.1 0.2 2.5];
elts = [[1, 2, 3]]
m = Mesh(coords, elts, 2);
mplot(m) |> mconf()
```

## Referenzwerte

```{julia}
ke_ref = [
     1.39122807 -1.19736842 -0.19385965
    -1.19736842  1.33421053 -0.13684211
    -0.19385965 -0.13684211  0.33070175
]
re_ref = [1.9475, 1.9475, 1.9475];
```

## Berechnung und Vergleich

### Elementmatrix

```{julia}
kef = heat_ke(1.3)
ke = kef(element(m, 1))

println("Ke = ", ke)
println("Elementmatrix OK: ", ke ≈ ke_ref)
```

### Elementvektor

```{julia}
ref = heat_re(4.1)
re = ref(element(m, 1))

println("re =", re)
println("Elementvektor OK: ", re ≈ re_ref)
```
